capabilities: Search and preview up to 50 matching icons in a picker
Insert static namespaced icon-font markup into notes
Switch icon packs inside the picker and set a default pack in settings
Insert icons via command palette, editor context menu, or ribbon icon
Configure space placement around inserted icons
extras: Upgrading from 1.0.0 requires deleting the old iconfine.css snippet and .woff2 files, since fonts are now bundled in styles.css. Bundled fonts keep their own licenses (Lucide ISC/MIT, Tabler MIT) under the plugin's Apache-2.0 license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert font icons into notes; icon images or CSS snippets break color inheritance and PDF export.
summary: Icon picker plugin that searches bundled Lucide and Tabler icon fonts and inserts static HTML markup that inherits text color and exports to PDF.
